tool_input.command:
cd <repo>/internal/daemon && python3 - <<'EOF'
p=open('pipeline.go').read()
p=p.replace('''			replyResult, _, err := runner.Run(ctx, e, p, len(p.Commands), replyCmd, replyCall, pipe, pipeTruncated)''','''			// A capped CLI stage leaves a silently partial pipe; tell the
			// sender. The notice is daemon-authored and added here, where
			// pipeTruncated is carried.
			replyPipe := pipe
			if pipeTruncated {
				replyPipe += truncationNotice
			}
			replyResult, _, err := runner.Run(ctx, e, p, len(p.Commands), replyCmd, replyCall, replyPipe, pipeTruncated)''')
p=p.replace('// sanitizeText strips','''// truncationNotice marks an auto-reply whose body was cut at the CLI stdout cap.
const truncationNotice = "\\n[output truncated at 1MB]\\n"

// sanitizeText strips''',1)
open('pipeline.go','w').write(p)
full=open('../../.tmp/pipeline_test.full').read()
i=full.index('// TestExecutor_AutoReplyCarriesTruncationNotice')
open('pipeline_test.go','a').write('\n'+full[i:])
EOF
go run mvdan.cc/gofumpt@latest -l . ; go run mvdan.cc/gofumpt@latest -w pipeline_test.go; go vet . && go test -race -count=1 -run TestExecutor_ . 2>&1 | tail; cd ../..; git add internal/daemon/pipeline.go internal/daemon/pipeline_test.go; (make check > .tmp/chk.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?" >> .tmp/chk.log); tail -3 .tmp/chk.log
